technical_caveats: Reviewed from the Parcel Shapefiles Readme (owner-supplied text, 2026-10-20). PIN files carry FID, Shape and PARCELNO only and no tax-roll attributes; PAR files are PIN files joined to NAL/preliminary tax roll and are NOT covered by this approval (the approval excludes NAL/SDF attributes), so only PIN files are used. Join: PARCELNO in the shapefile to PARCEL_ID in the NAL file. Parcel identifier formatting: CSV NAL or SDF files may alter formatting, so matching uses the shapefile's own PARCELNO value (DBF), never a reformatted copy. Expected differences in counts: the county shapefile export date (due to PTO by April 1) versus the tax roll (due by July 1); Chapter 119 redacted records have a polygon but no NAL record; some polygons (e.g. certain public rights-of-way) have no record. Condominiums: some counties do not map every unit, and some keep related tables; Miami-Dade and St. Johns keep condo records in separate files. A stacked-polygon method can leave a phantom base polygon. Multi-parcel polygons (non-contiguous parcels with common ownership listed under one tax parcel) can make one polygon cover several records. Polygons with unknown ownership may have no tax record. Refreshes are expected each August. Nothing here changes the permission conditions. Broward 2025 PIN file examined (owner-supplied set: .dbf, .prj, .shx, .sbn, .sbx, .shp.xml, .cpg; the .shp polygon file was NOT supplied): 786,580 features; attribute table holds PARCELNO only (12 characters, no padding, no leading zeros); 764,726 distinct values; 21,854 features share a PARCELNO with another feature (8,071 values, the largest shared by 359 features) - stacked/condominium cases that the matcher must refuse as AMBIGUOUS; 36% of values contain letters, so identifiers must not be treated as digits-only. Projection: NAD83 HARN Florida East, US feet (EPSG 2881), so geometry must be reprojected to WGS84 before use. Metadata: published 2025-03-21; PARCELNO was derived from FOLIO in the 2025 merge. Counts only: no parcel value is recorded here.
